lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately six visible vertical columns of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters posterior to the gill slits. Each column contains 3 to 5 distinct nodes of varying intensity.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical spot columns, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature running along the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal side to a distinct shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several high-contrast, elongated objects (commensal fish) positioned near the ventral margin and pectoral fin; the pectoral fin exhibits a significantly higher spatial density of smaller high-luminance spots compared to the primary flank patterning.
